Texas congressional districts districts as redrawn by the Texas Legislature in a 2025 special session.
Changes from the previous map highlighted.

In June 2025, lawmakers in the U.S. state of Texas began considering a process of mid-decade legislative redistricting plan to give members of the Republican Party in the state an advantage by gerrymandering the state's congressional districts ahead of the 2026 United States House of Representatives elections.
